description: Parses WorldAtlas.com articles to extract geographical content including country borders, statistics, and educational information with structured data extraction.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - fetch_article: Fetch and parse a specific WorldAtlas article URL; requires url parameter; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - search_articles: Search for articles on WorldAtlas; requires query parameter; 参数: query, max_results; 必填: query
  - get_bordering_countries: Get countries bordering a specific country; requires country parameter; 参数: country; 必填: country

url.description: Full URL of a WorldAtlas article to fetch and parse (used by fetch_article function)

query.description: Search query to find WorldAtlas articles (used by search_articles function)

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (used by search_articles function)

country.description: Name of the country to find bordering countries for (used by get_bordering_countries function)
